summary: Verified alert-removal + dynamic-fetch (no-stale-data) bookmarklet changes end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass for GET /api/orders/{id}/autofill (public, no auth), 404 for unknown id, freshness after PUT, and CORS. Frontend/Playwright: decoded bookmarklet href from admin dialog - no 'alert(' substring and no order values hardcoded; autofill URL /api/orders/<id>/autofill IS embedded; executing the bookmarklet on /shcil-mock.html filled all 7 target fields correctly (txtPurBy, txtDesc, txtConsidr, txtFp, txtSp, txtDuty, ddlPaidBy=First Party); page.on('dialog') never fired. Freshness: updated the order (purchased_by -> 'Suresh Mehta') and re-ran the SAME bookmarklet JS on the mock page; the field was repopulated with the new value, proving live fetch. Copy Code button still visible/working.

minor.issue: Returned 422 for an order created with the valid 7-field OrderData payload used in this test (likely requires additional fields such as first_party_address1/pin/pan/mobile/email/gender/mode_of_payment/proof_of_identity/proof_of_residence). Not blocking the autofill flow since PUT and GET /autofill work on draft orders, and the submitted order was still visible to admin.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/orders/{id}/autofill is intentionally public (no auth) and returns only order['data'] - fine for the UUID-gated bookmarklet use case; consider rate-limiting if abuse becomes a concern.
bookmarklet.js: fetch uses {cache:'no-store'} - good, guarantees freshness. Native setter + input/change/blur dispatch retained for React-controlled inputs.

bookmarklet.js: errors are only console.error'd (no user-visible failure state). On real shcilestamp.com, if fetch fails (CORS/offline), user sees nothing. Consider a subtle non-blocking toast (e.g., a temporary floating div) rather than reintroducing alert().

context_for_next_testing_agent: Flow verified: (1) decode href by stripping 'javascript:' and urllib.unquote; (2) assert 'alert(' not in decoded and no literal order values; (3) assert '/api/orders/<id>/autofill' in decoded; (4) page.goto /shcil-mock.html, evaluate `eval(<decoded>)`, wait 2s, check 7 inputs; (5) PUT /api/orders/{id} with new purchased_by, re-run bookmarklet, verify updated value. Register page.on('dialog', ...) and assert empty. Note: /api/orders/{id}/submit returned 422 with just the 7 'required' fields from the spec - submission validation may require more fields.
rca of the issue: N/A - both changes (alert removal + dynamic fetch) are correctly implemented and verified.
